title: Tackling sign language data inequity
description: ASL Citizen is the first crowdsourced sign language dataset, advancing the state of the art in sign recognition. The web-based project captured input from people in real-world settings, and from a diverse group of experts, including Deaf team members. The post Tackling sign language data inequity appeared first on Microsoft Research .

title: Why GPUs Are Great for AI
